blocks.text: Charles Darwin English sciencedan the. 1831 mein woh His Majesty's Ship Beagle par saainsi muhim mein mahir-e-fitrat ki haisiyat se gaye, yaani duniya ke gird paanch saal ka safar.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka naqsha: narangi khushki, halka neela samandar. Gehri neeli lakeer teeron ke saath Beagle ka raasta dikhati hai: Plymouth se junoob mein Tenerife aur Cape Verde se Rio de Janeiro, Falkland Islands ke paas South America ke gird, maghribi sahil par Galapagos aur phir maghrib ki taraf; mashriq se Sydney, Hobart, Mauritius aur Cape Town se guzar kar Atlantic paar wapas Plymouth. Surkh nuqte parao hain; Plymouth aur Galapagos gulabi, baqi aath gehre neele label mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.1: HMS Beagle ke raaste ke bare parao (kitab ki Figure 24.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Raasta Plymouth (England) se shuru ho kar wahin khatam hota hai. Galapagos ke baad lakeer naqshe ke baayen kinare se nikalti aur daayen kinare se wapas aati hai, kyunke Bahr-e-Kahil (Pacific) naqshe ke dono kinaron par bata hua hai. Gulabi labels (Plymouth, Galapagos) sab se ahem jaghein hain.
